# OpenMagpie

> Open-source, self-hostable social listening. You curate sources into a feed,
> describe what's relevant in plain language, and a local LLM scores each new
> item against it. Matches go to your logs or a webhook; everything else is
> dropped. Sources today: Reddit, Hacker News, and any RSS/Atom feed.

Setup is two YAML files applied via the `magpie` CLI: a `feed.yaml` (which
sources to pull) and a `watch.yaml` (a semantic filter plus where matches go).
To help someone set one up, read the config guide and the closest starter, then
produce their feed.yaml + watch.yaml and the `magpie create` commands. The CLI
validates on create and rejects malformed YAML with a specific error, so iterate
against it rather than guessing. A single inlined copy of everything below, for
assistants that can't follow links, is at /llms-full.txt.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/obris-dev/openmagpie/blob/main/README.md): what it is, capabilities, install and quickstart
- [Config guide](https://github.com/obris-dev/openmagpie/blob/main/config/README.md): source kinds (reddit_subreddit, hn_feed, hn_comment, RSS) and every feed/watch field

## Schema reference

- [openmagpie-schema](https://github.com/obris-dev/openmagpie/tree/main/packages/openmagpie-schema/src/openmagpie_schema): Pydantic models for source specs, feed payloads, and watch actions (semantic_filter, log, webhook)

## Worked examples (copy and adapt)

- [Starters index and AI-assisted setup](https://github.com/obris-dev/openmagpie/blob/main/examples/README.md)
- [hackernews](https://github.com/obris-dev/openmagpie/tree/main/examples/starters/hackernews): HN stories (hn_feed)
- [hackernews-comments](https://github.com/obris-dev/openmagpie/tree/main/examples/starters/hackernews-comments): keyword-filtered HN comments (hn_comment)
- [selfhosted-opensource](https://github.com/obris-dev/openmagpie/tree/main/examples/starters/selfhosted-opensource) and [devtools](https://github.com/obris-dev/openmagpie/tree/main/examples/starters/devtools): Reddit examples

## CLI quick reference

- `magpie quickstart`: interactive guided setup
- `magpie feed template` and `magpie watch template`: print the exact YAML shape to adapt
- `magpie feed create -f feed.yaml`, then `magpie watch create -f watch.yaml`: apply them (validates; put the printed feed id into watch.yaml's feed_ids)
- `magpie activity summary --action <id>`: see matches

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/obris-dev/openmagpie/blob/main/AGENTS.md): contributor and dev conventions (not needed to set up a listener)
